title: Project Handbook
description: Provides guidelines to FABRIX partners about common practices to be employed in daily operations. The Handbook is a collection of various project policies, working procedures, forms and guidelines needed to create and maintain an efficient project structure and a practical approach for the implementation of the Grant Agreement and the Consortium Agreement.

title: External Communication: Project identity, website and social media
description: Outlines the objectives and partners involved in the communication strategy; the available communication tools including project branding, templates, website, social media, newsletter and promotional kits; and the communication KPIs.

title: Academic Dissemination plan
description: Outlines key components crucial for effective project management and academic dissemination. This document integrates the academic dissemination strategy, quality assurance procedures, communication frameworks among partners, and risk management approaches.

title: Theoretical and conceptual frameworks
description: The document lays out a comprehensive framework to guide research across the project, which aims to establish sustainable, regenerative textile and clothing (T&C) ecosystems through local, circular manufacturing systems in urban areas

title: Methodological framework
description: This deliverable outlines the methodologies developed and used for the FABRIX project

title: Identification and improvement of indicators for the circular and social system self-assessment tool (Intermediate Version)
description: This deliverable presents the design, adaptation, and validation of responsibility with the European textile and clothing (T&C) sector.
